expectations.text: Computes the exact local file byte length, rather than a character count or an estimated value.
expectations.evidence: Computes `report_bytes="$(wc -c < ./report.pdf | tr -d '[:space:]')"` and prints that local length; says "`wc -c` measures the actual binary byte length."

expectations.text: Passes that numeric byte length as --header Content-Length=<value> on sending:upload-attachment.
expectations.evidence: Measures and prints `report_bytes`, but the complete `sending:upload-attachment` invocation omits `--header Content-Length` and never passes the measured value to upload.
The upload invocation includes `--body-file ./report.pdf`, `--query filename=report.pdf`, `--query content_type=application/pdf` and `--json`.

expectations.text: Uses the existing work profile without printing or requesting credentials.
expectations.evidence: Uses `--profile work` and states "uses credentials from the existing `work` profile"; no credential requested or printed.

expectations.text: Uses standalone upload only, with no sending:send, MCP send or --attach send command.
expectations.evidence: Only local byte measurement/printing and `sending:upload-attachment` are proposed; states "without sending an email." No send command or `--attach`.

expectations.text: Does not claim an attachment_id or completed upload without a real result.
expectations.evidence: States "These commands have not been run; no upload result is available." No attachment_id or completed-upload claim.

grader_provenance.assessment_source: Grader read all six actual saved responses against exact prepared assertions, verified immutable assigned source body hashes and source-definition prompt/assertion equality; grader did not author either evaluation answer.
